subject: Wedding reception — Saturday June 14
body:
Hi,

We're getting married in June and looking for a reception space for around 120 guests. We'd like a sit-down dinner, then speeches, then dancing into the evening. One of our guests uses a wheelchair so we'll need step-free access throughout.

Could you let us know availability and a rough quote?

Thanks,
Sarah

subject: Tech workshop hire — 40 people
body:
Hello,

We need a room for a half-day technical workshop for about 40 people. Everyone will be on laptops — theatre-style or classroom seating facing a screen/projector would be ideal. No food required beyond tea and coffee if you can arrange it.

Best,
Priya

subject: MD leaving party
body:
Hi there,

We're hosting a leaving party for our MD. Expecting around 80 people. The plan is drinks and canapés then sit down for dinner. Speeches at some point. East-side bar would be lovely if you have one.

Cheers,
James

subject: Awards night — everyone seated
body:
Good morning,

We are planning our annual awards night for approximately 200 guests. Everyone should be seated for the ceremony (cabaret or banquet), with a stage for presenters and a lectern. AV / projector for the winner slides please.

Kind regards,
Amelia Frost

subject: Networking evening
body:
Hi,

Looking to book a networking evening for about 150 people — standing reception with high tables, a bar, and space to mingle. No sit-down meal.

Thanks,
Tom

subject: Charity gala dinner — 300 guests
body:
Dear Events Team,

We would like to host our charity gala with 300 guests for a formal banquet dinner, stage for speeches, dancing afterwards, and full step-free access. Please advise if you can accommodate.

Yours sincerely,
Olivia Grant

subject: Kids birthday party
body:
Hi,

Birthday party for our daughter — about 25 kids and a few parents. Soft drinks, a cake table, maybe space for games. Nothing too formal. Saturday afternoon if possible.

Thanks,
Mark

subject: Product launch with panel talk
body:
Hello,

We're launching a new product and need space for around 90 people. Format is networking on arrival, then a panel talk with seating facing the stage, plus a projector for slides. Drinks after.

Best regards,
Nina
